seo_title: The Sundune | Palm Springs Condo with Three King Beds
seo_description: A two-bedroom Palm Springs condo with three king beds, two bathrooms, a balcony, and shared pool and hot tub access. Sleeps four, with a full kitchen.
tagline: Three king beds for your Palm Springs stay.
description_heading: Three king beds, room for four.
description_p1: The Sundune is a two-bedroom, two-bath condo in Palm Springs with three king beds and room for up to four guests.
description_p2: There’s a full kitchen, laundry, and a balcony with bar-top dining, plus access to a shared community pool and hot tub.
description_p3: Coastal colors, rattan, and linen curtains give the rooms their own personality. A standing desk and WiFi are here if you need to work during your stay.
description_p4: Downtown Palm Springs and the Uptown Design District are a drive away. Take a look through the rooms, or email us if you want to check the setup before booking.
